entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider offering a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It features multi-signal retrieval and temporal reasoning, available via a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication. It combines RAG and memory through hybrid search and includes connectors for GitHub, Notion, Gmail, Google Drive, and OneDrive.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for OpenClaw/Hermes Agents that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges. It provides synthesized answers with gap analysis and citations, supporting scoped access for multi-user team environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system for agents that implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and offers clients for Go, Node.js, Python, and CLI.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for stateful agents that provides hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It includes a FastAPI server for self-hosted or managed use and supports TypeScript and Python SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like versioning, including commit, branch, and merge operations. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that operates using a single SQLite database. It supports a Python SDK for direct operations and MCP via SSE or stdio.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agents utilizing a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context. Its local infrastructure is built on Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that uses outcome-gated promotion for playbooks and context bundles. It integrates with OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Pi extensions, and MCP clients via Python and TypeScript implementations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a DAG-based engine to prevent message loss. It employs a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted memory backend that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup script.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer provides portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy by importing data from sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores human-readable YAML engrams locally for multi-agent systems. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools like Claude Code and Cursor using hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, to provide memory through MCP and agent hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates inference for Hermes Agent by reordering blocks and deduplicating context for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a durable, file-based system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It supports embedded in-process operation and includes features for contradiction tracking and owner-scoping in multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate an RAG cache. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models locally to serve context via an MCP-native server.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that combines semantic search with ranked graph traversal and BM25 full-text indexing. It automatically indexes codebases and multimedia while creating bidirectional relationships between notes via edge tags.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only the context they actually need. This local-first layer uses SQLite and offline embeddings to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent memory. It prioritizes high-value information through importance-weighted recall and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This tool provides a shared lifecycle kernel for Hermes that stores durable context and decision logs in plain Markdown. It features a Git-backed workflow for converting chat archives into reviewable files for coding agents.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to ensure recall is not affected by persistent, outdated summaries.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo enables cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The system includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching and state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across ten different chain families. It allows APIs to charge for access and agents to pay for services with just a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local Markdown files, cron jobs, and MCP configurations to provide artifact search and retrieval capabilities. It includes five specialized tools and supports opt-in automatic tool-routing note generation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It features configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the accuracy of manual and automated memory retrieval.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods with MinHash deduplication for robust data management.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation loop uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned Markdown memories without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that provides CLI support for 26 executables, including Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness. It allows agents to export artifacts to formats like HTML and MP4 while utilizing a sandboxed iframe for live design previews.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped across 34 domains and multiple frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance security-focused agent capabilities.

entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It functions as a master router that includes escrow, verification, and dispute resolution layers.

entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses an agentic evolver to automate skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions. It synchronizes skill libraries across team environments and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 12 metaskills that preserve state within a local directory for agentskills.io-compatible agents. The skills are available as spec-conformant plugins designed for use with Claude Code.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,153 professional agent skills in plain markdown format that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for other assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists from YouTube. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Windsurf, and other major coding assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing agents to manage their own capabilities via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances reporting by providing findings alongside an assessment of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for Pydantic AI through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries for programmatic skills.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by combining prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.

entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuration.

entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a web server to drive self-hosted Hermes agents from a mobile device. It allows users to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with integrated custom LLM model routing. It provides a runtime dashboard for monitoring token usage and latency while tracking live code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard serves as a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health. It distinguishes itself with real-time tool call visualization and an integrated MCP server management system for controlling server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit designed to track live quota burn and analytics across 13 different agent sources. It prioritizes privacy through local operation with no telemetry, offering searchable transcripts and image browsing without remote data uploads.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It stands out by integrating a WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for interactive communication.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It is specifically designed for oversight, featuring an approval inbox to manage agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this project provides a terminal-based user interface and dashboard for managing Hermes Agent sessions and profiles. It includes specialized tools for agentic work, such as a kanban board for task management and controls for skills and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based SPA brings Hermes functionality to Telegram Mini Apps with a 10-page mobile-first UI and dual HMAC-SHA256/Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning, allowing users to run up to five concurrent instances with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop solution that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes Agent with local or cloud models. It features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers alongside integrated support for TTS and ComfyUI workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides a visual environment for real-time log streaming and chat interactions with a self-hosted AI assistant. It includes dedicated modules for file browsing, task tracking, and the management of MCP servers and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Focused on process monitoring and configuration, this dashboard tracks session activity and associated costs in real time. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code while providing read-only access to environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, supported by isolated profile management for distinct API keys and memory sets.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and supports fluid model switching during streaming chat sessions.
